row.body: A locker key is attached to a rental ledger that marks the unit cleared; the renter’s return signature is absent.
row.title: The missing locker handoff

sidecar.gloss: A storage ledger closes a unit without the renter’s return.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program crew could leave a unit unused and cancel its rental; the missing signature does not show whether anyone collected the contents.

row.body: the hand mirror and briefcase are bound with a torn sleeve. the fabric is smoke-stained outside and spotless beneath the knot.
row.title: missing count beside the hand mirror

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
